blocks.headline: Kingdom-minded marketing for Kingdom-minded businesses
blocks.body: A full marketing team, led by senior marketers and powered by apprentices training for a life of purpose.

blocks.heading: Your growth funds their calling
blocks.body:
Vertical Studios is the creative and marketing arm of Vertical Life. Businesses and nonprofits get strategy, design, content, websites and campaigns run by experienced marketers.

Behind them, [Vertical Immersive](/vertical-immersive) apprentices handle production under direct supervision, doing real work with real stakes.

items.title: Senior-led
items.body: Run by marketers with agency, nonprofit and in-house backgrounds.

items.title: Apprentice-powered
items.body: A full production crew learning the craft by doing it.

items.title: Full-service
items.body: Social, web, design, video, strategy and marketing automation.

blocks.heading: Elevate your business
blocks.body: Empower the next generation while you grow. See services, past work and the team on the Vertical Studios site, or schedule a discovery call.
